units.source_text: 殿上燃起纸烛，大家奉献祝歌。

en.t: Paper tapers were lit in the palace hall, and everyone offered congratulatory songs.

units.source_text: 走近文台来呈献歌稿的人，个个脸上得意扬扬。

en.t: Those who came up to the writing desk to present their poem drafts all looked pleased with themselves.

units.source_text: 然而这些诗歌，想必照例是稀奇古怪的陈腔滥调，

en.t: Yet these poems were probably, as usual, odd and affected pieces full of worn out old phrases,

units.source_text: 所以笔者并不特地向人探询而一一记录。

en.t: so the writer did not go out of the way to ask about them and record each one.

units.source_text: 几位地位高贵的王侯，所咏的诗歌并不特别优秀。

en.t: The poems composed by several princes and nobles of high rank were not especially fine either.

units.source_text: 为欲纪念这个盛会，探询得一二首在此。

en.t: Still, to commemorate this splendid gathering, I asked around and obtained one or two poems to include here.

units.source_text: 这一首大约是薰大将走下庭中来折取藤花、奉献皇上饰冠时所咏的歌吧：

en.t: This one was probably composed when General Kaoru went down into the garden, broke off wisteria blossoms, and offered them to adorn the emperor's crown:
